ruleInterpretation.basis: Current official hero/API and current OL client 3582 use X = characters with no Hand cards + 1. The native target instruction freezes living empty-Hand count + 1 when it actually begins. The separate mandatory per-damage draw recalculates and freezes X when it begins; multiple points in one real damage occurrence do not create multiple draws. These timing details are implementation inferences; no dedicated official FAQ was found.

ruleInterpretation.rule: First X true uses in the whole actual turn
ruleInterpretation.basis: Each true native Use occupies one ordinal, including equipment, targetless cards, zero-entity uses, Slash-defense Dodge and self-supplied Nullification. Pure played/provided responses, recast and material movements do not. Raw TurnEnded does not end a still-running actual turn with an inserted tail phase; actual cursor return does. The new declaration sequence is distinct from the historical AHui ordinal contract. Original immutable declarations follow an exact native actor-replacement chain within the current declaration prefix; a new actor does not borrow the old actor ordinal. This final-actor attribution and complete-actual-turn cutoff are implementation inferences.

Bingzhong provides a target-count allowance and does not remove distance, target prohibitions, self restrictions, required target cards or native card structure. The native equipment and delayed-card hosts retain their ordinary single-zone material structure; they still consume an ordinal. Borrowed Sword counts each additional holder/victim pair as one additional designated target. Select zero through X legal additions, without changing the already-paid Use or paying its Slash quota again. No official special equipment/delayed-card target whitelist is claimed.

Current official text says the other character uses one random equipment from the deck. Select among genuinely legal stock equipment with the native deterministic random source, then issue a real foreign-actor equipment Use. Replacement, Lion recovery, Ox grain cleanup, abolished-slot termination, movement, health, dying and skill-loss children complete before the following Slash. Empty legal stock produces no fabricated equipment but proceeds to the Slash. This empty-stock/failed-entry continuation is a text/native sequencing inference.

After all equipment children, the living original owner may issue one genuine zero-entity Slash against the surviving original recipient under current ordinary native range, quota and prohibitions. A counted own-Play Slash debits its real native quota once. No fake phase, distance bypass or equipment-card substitute is introduced. Already-issued payment/children return after skill loss; a dead owner never starts a new Slash. These boundaries are implementation inferences because no same-product dedicated FAQ was found.

verification.scope: Four focused Core behavior groups cover the new rules and native child boundaries. Shared registry, replay, privacy and WPF checks use the bounded routine scope. Full verification remains manual-only.
verification.note: Measured development-run results are kept with task verification output rather than duplicated in the lasting source evidence.
